notes.title: Mini Patch 0.05
notes.notes:
* If player is killed by an enemy, helpful hints will appear during the death sequence screen to guide players

* Added "-" and "+" signs to the settings menu for Brightness, Audio, and Mouse Sensitivity settings so players have a better sense of which direction is decrease/increase

* Added an ending screen for Players (an email from Genesis Employers) :))))

notes.title: June 23 Patch
notes.notes:
* Added clarification to instructions in the main hall: Player cannot sprint while holding the phone

* Added clarification to instructions in the main hall: There is only ONE target vehicle in each parking section now (separated by Section C, Section B, Section A)

* Added clarification regarding enemy behavior: Some enemies ONLY have vision and no hearing. Player can simply crouch/hide behind cars to avoid them. Some enemies ONLY have hearing and no vision; in this case, player will need to be crouching or walking to avoid detection. Other enemies have both; in this case, a combination of tactics will be needed.

notes.title: Mini Update 0.03
notes.notes:
Patched a few tiny issues after the first major update, including:

- Respawn bug (fixed player stuck in slow speed after respawning)
- Level 2 AI Adjustment (Decreased the difficulty for Level 2 AI)

notes.title: Update Patch for June 8
notes.notes:
* Added Japanese language translation to game interface
* Adjusted difficulty of enemy AI
* Added "Employee of the Month" achievement that can be acquired by finding all the cars
* Fixed bug of player executing the death animation twice 
* Adjusted the spawn frequency of enemies
